data.narrative: The student successfully implemented DB-native search with strict query filtering, pagination metadata, and strict query size capping. They demonstrated robust production thinking by incorporating allowlisted sorting parameters and tenant scoping to protect against injection and unauthorized data access.

dimension_scores.observation: Correctly chose DB-native search over external search engines to maintain architectural simplicity and immediate consistency.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose Option A to avoid operational overhead and ensure immediate consistency upon link creation.

dimension_scores.observation: Successfully reproduced and fixed a pagination off-by-one indexing error by correcting the offset calculation formula.
dimension_scores.evidence: Injected an off-by-one boundary bug, observed record skipping during search, corrected the slice formula, and verified via regression test.

dimension_scores.observation: Implemented strict input allowlisting for sort fields and enforced tenant scoping via principal_id isolation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Validated sort_by against an allowed set and scoped search results to authenticated principals.

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced strict page size limits (capped at 100) using query validation to prevent database resource exhaustion.
dimension_scores.evidence: Configured FastAPI Query constraints (le=100) to reject unbounded requests.

dimension_scores.observation: Clearly explained the security and operational risks associated with unbounded queries and SQL string concatenation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Answered verification questions explaining SQLi risks and DoS prevention via page size capping.

data.recommendation: As dataset sizes grow into millions of records, consider implementing database GIN indexes and cursor-based pagination.

public_evidence.student_action: Implemented a secure search endpoint with keyword filtering, tag filtering, allowlisted sorting, page size capping, and strict tenant isolation.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Created GET /api/links/search with FastAPI Query validation (le=100), allowlisted sort fields, and principal_id tenant scoping.
public_evidence.proof: Regression test output demonstrating successful keyword search, pagination metadata calculation, and validation rejection for unbounded page size requests.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates the candidate knows how to build secure, performant search endpoints that prevent injection and database resource exhaustion.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Corrected off-by-one slicing and allowlisted sort parameters.

teaching_approaches.detail: Injected an off-by-one slice calculation bug to demonstrate record skipping.

learning_style_signals: Thrives when combining security protections (input allowlisting) with rigorous pagination boundary verification.
